method: Read-only Blender FBX reimport of all four corrected police clips, with anim_offset=0 and importer-inferred bone connections cleared to preserve the source unconnected-bone contract and keyed translations; compared with authored source at every integer frame. Technical bone/skin/pose checks only; art acceptance is recorded separately. Unity editor was not available.

limitations: No Unity compilation, PlayMode, runtime animation blending, or GPU performance validation.
Stylized early character geometry; this is a focused wrist and grip correction, not final AAA character art.
